title.narrative: Financiamiento Suplementario para la Central Hidroelectrica Peligre
Supplementary Financing for the Peligre Hydroelectric Plant

description.narrative: El Programa tiene como objetivo contribuir a recuperar y conservar la capacidad de generacin de energa elctrica en Hait por medio de fuentes de energa renovable, a travs de la rehabilitacin de la CHP y asegurar su suministro a la capital del pas, mediante la rehabilitacin de la lnea de transmisin a Puerto Prncipe.

The objective of the program is help restore and preserve Haitis capacity to generate electrical power with renewable energy sources by rehabilitating the Pligre Hydroelectric Plant and to ensure the supply of electricity to Haitis capital by rehabilitating the transmission line to Port-au-Prince.
